etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Middle English utensyl, from Old French utensile, from Latin ūtēnsilis (“useful, usable”).

definitions.definition: An instrument or device for domestic use, especially in the kitchen.
A useful small tool, implement, or vessel.

quote.citation: 1954, Tom Lehrer (lyrics and music), “A Christmas Carol”:
quote.text: Relations, sparing no expense'll/Send some useless old utensil,/Or a matching pen and pencil./"just the thing I need! how nice!"
